lead_fa: Protection Paladin یک تانک سپردار است که با چرخهٔ تولید و خرج کردن Holy Power، آسیب‌گیری را با [[Shield of the Righteous]] نرم می‌کند و با blessing ها پشتیبانی بی‌نظیری به گروه می‌دهد. پچ 12.1 ریموک بزرگ درخت اسپک و باف‌های قابل توجه برای او آورد. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Templar]] با [[Hammer of Light]] و [[Lightsmith]] با Holy Armaments؛ در اکثر محتواها هر دو خیلی نزدیک‌اند.

strengths: Excellent group utility through blessings: Blessing of Sacrifice, Blessing of Freedom, Blessing of Protection
Strong self and raid healing with Word of Glory and Hand of the Protector
Very good at handling Magic damage and Bleeds: Blessing of Protection, Divine Shield, Blessing of Spellwarding, plus passive reduction from Mastery: Divine Bulwark
Multiple crowd control options: Hammer of Justice, Turn Evil, Blinding Light
Cleanse Toxins removes poisons and diseases from party and raid members
weaknesses: Without 3 Holy Power or a Divine Purpose proc, Shield of the Righteous takes a few seconds to activate; Ardent Defender on the pull offsets this
Second-lowest health pool of all tanks
Punishing to mistakes: short reaction windows and easy deaths when caught unprepared
Very limited mobility: Divine Steed is the only baseline speed ability
Knockback and forced-movement mechanics require spending Divine Shield, Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Spellwarding

nerfs: Hammer of Light damage reduced by 33%
Divine Exaction's Divine Toll effectiveness reduced to 80% (was 150%)
buffs: New talent Blessed Word: Word of Glory can no longer critically strike, but its healing scales with your critical strike chance and 80% of overhealing grants an absorb shield
Improved Ardent Defender redesigned: increases maximum HP by 20% while active and no longer cancels remaining duration on fatal damage
Seal of Reprisal redesigned: Blessed Hammer reduces enemy damage dealt to you by 10% for 8 seconds
Shield of the Righteous damage increased by 150%
Hammer of the Righteous primary damage increased by 50%
Avenging Wrath increases damage and healing by 10% and critical strike by 10%
Sentinel duration increased to 20 seconds and inherits Avenging Wrath's critical strike bonus
Bulwark of Order absorb increased to 75% of Avenger's Shield damage (was 60%)
Sacred Weapon and Holy Bulwark extend their duration when reapplied by the same caster
Many talents changed position in the tree
changes_12_1.note: Patch 12.1 brought a significant spec tree rework plus largely favorable tuning for Protection Paladin.

hero.recommendation: Both hero trees are very close in all content per Wowhead; Lightsmith carries the (Best) tag for Raid and Mythic+ builds while Templar is (Best) for Delves, so play whichever you prefer. Templar: use Divine Toll and Hammer of Light on cooldown, then focus the rotation on Judgment and Blessed Hammer/Hammer of the Righteous to maximize Shake the Heavens duration; you must take Divine Toll in the class tree. Lightsmith: cast Holy Bulwark or Sacred Weapon once per minute; during Avenging Wrath generate as much Holy Power as possible to maximize Blessing of the Forge, otherwise play the normal rotation.
hero.templar: Divine Toll and Hammer of Light on cooldown; Judgment and Blessed Hammer/Hammer of the Righteous keep Shake the Heavens up for as long as possible.
hero.lightsmith: Holy Bulwark or Sacred Weapon once per minute; stack Holy Power generation inside Avenging Wrath windows to maximize Blessing of the Forge.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead marks the builds (Best) per mode: Lightsmith for Raid and Mythic+, Templar for Delves; the text explicitly says both are close in all content.

concepts: Never overcap Holy Power: it fuels damage, mitigation and healing; wasting it is a direct loss.
Generate resources: Hammer of Wrath, Judgment and Blessed Hammer build Holy Power.
Smooth damage intake: Shield of the Righteous at 3-5 Holy Power is the default spender.
Heal yourself: Word of Glory around 40-50% health or before a big hit, as long as it does not drop Shield of the Righteous.
Plan your defensives ahead of time: the spec feels squishy when no cooldown is ready to roll.
Build Holy Power, spend Holy Power.
st_priority: Cast Hammer of Light on cooldown
Cast Shield of the Righteous at 3-5 Holy Power or when free; try not to cap Holy Power
Word of Glory if your health drops below 50% or before a big hit
Divine Toll at 0 Holy Power; use it on cooldown as much as possible, synced with Avenging Wrath
Blessed Hammer / Hammer of the Righteous on cooldown
rotation.aoe_note: Keep Judgment and Blessed Hammer on cooldown as much as possible and fill the remaining GCDs with Avenger's Shield and Consecration; AoE is largely baked into the natural toolkit.

cooldowns.Avenging Wrath: Cast on cooldown; it changes Judgment into Hammer of Wrath and increases damage, healing and critical strike chance.
cooldowns.Ardent Defender: Usable on the pull to offset the few seconds before the first Shield of the Righteous when no Holy Power or Divine Purpose proc is ready.
cooldowns.Guardian of Ancient Kings: A major defensive cooldown; plan it for predictable large damage windows.
cooldowns.Divine Shield: Full immunity; also the tool to prevent knockbacks or forced movement when Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Spellwarding is not the right answer.

gearing_rules: Haste = Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility as the guideline; never neglect Strength.
Use Raidbots to sim your own character.
Focus on completing the tier set bonus.
Pick up both offensive and defensive trinkets.
Aim for gear with high Haste and Crit where possible.

tier_set.name: Radiance of the Consecrated Flame
tier_set.note: 2pc: Consecration is 30% larger and enemies inside it are illuminated, gaining 5% chance for your abilities to critically strike them. 4pc: enemies struck by Judgment or Blessed Hammer/Hammer of the Righteous take 20% additional Holy damage, increased to 100% extra when struck by a critical strike.

stats.cheatsheet: Survivability: Strength > Haste > Mastery > Critical Strike > Versatility; DPS: Strength > Haste > Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility.
notes: Protection prefers a balance of Haste and Crit primarily, with Mastery just behind after the diminishing-return points.
Crit has significant interaction with both hero trees while Haste speeds up the rotation and Holy Power generation.
Simming is only appropriate for offensive information, not survivability.
stats.dr_breakpoints: Diminishing returns start above: Critical Strike 1380, Haste 1320, Mastery 1380, Versatility 1620 rating.

consumables.combat_potion: Draught of Rampant Abandon or Light's Potential

mplus.hero_note: Lightsmith carries the (Best) tag for Mythic+ builds and Templar is right behind; Wowhead notes both heroes are close in all content.
tips: Blessings are your dungeon superpower: Blessing of Sacrifice for dangerous pulls, Blessing of Protection to clear bleeds, Blessing of Spellwarding against magic burst.
Hammer of Justice, Turn Evil and Blinding Light cover most interrupt-and-CC needs on trash.
Cleanse Toxins removes poisons and diseases from the party without a healer GCD.
Plan defensives ahead: with the second-lowest health pool of all tanks, getting caught without a cooldown ready is fatal.
Divine Steed is your only baseline mobility; spend Divine Shield or blessings to handle knockbacks and forced movement.
